% [S3] an algorithm float with algpseudocode
\begin{algorithm}[h]
\caption{Summing a range}\label{alg:sum}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require $n \ge 0$
\Ensure $s = \sum_{i \le n} i$
\State $s \gets 0$
\For{$i \gets 1, n$}
  \If{$i > 0$}\State $s \gets s + i$\Comment{accumulate}\EndIf
\EndFor
\LineComment{done}
\State \Return $s$
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
